+title: 'Example release-notes skill: use exact relative paths and include a reference'
+---
+## What
+`Examples/skill-library/project/.skills/release-notes/SKILL.md` is the fixture that the tests and the demo use for resources. Now its body says "this skill's bundled `references/` changelog and `scripts/` build script (plan.md §7.3 resource ops)". `plan.md` was deleted. The body must show the correct pattern for authors.
+
+- Change the body of `release-notes/SKILL.md`. The new body:
+  - names each file with its exact relative path (`references/changelog.md`, `scripts/build.sh`, `assets/logo.bin`), as the agentskills.io specification recommends;
+  - tells the model to read `references/changelog.md` with `read resource`, and to run `scripts/build.sh` with `run script`;
+  - does not refer to `plan.md`.
+- Add one small reference file that the body includes with `{% include "references/<name>.md" %}`, so the fixture uses the include feature one time. The README says the fixture "uses each templating and visibility feature one time".
+- Keep the `references/changelog.md` file long enough for the paging tests. Do not change its line count.
+- Update each test that compares the rendered body of `release-notes` (`Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/FixtureLibraryTests.swift`, `UseSkillPlainTextTests.swift`, `SkillsDemoTests.swift`, `ListResourceTests.swift`, and any other test that searches for the old text).
+- Write the body in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The body of `release-notes` holds the three exact relative paths and no reference to `plan.md`.
+- [ ] `use skill` of `release-notes` gives the body with the included reference text, then the file list.
+- [ ] `list resource` of `release-notes` gives the new reference file as a `reference` row.
+- [ ] The paging test of `references/changelog.md` gives the same result as now.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update the exact-text tests named above.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/UseSkillPlainTextTests.swift`: one test that the `release-notes` answer holds the included text and the file list.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no failure.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
